# Nada Sai

> Nada Sai is a free, 100% client-side, browser-based web application for editing images, PDF documents and audio files, and for privacy and security tasks such as encryption, hashing and redaction. All processing runs locally in the user’s browser using WebAssembly, WebAudio, WebCrypto and Web Workers — zero files or user data are ever uploaded to any server.

## Overview

Nada Sai provides 42 tools across 5 modules, all of which run entirely offline in the browser. Every tool exists at a Portuguese and an English URL; the pairs are listed in sitemap.xml.

## Image Tools

- [Remover fundo / Remove background](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/remover-fundo): Simply drop your image into the dropzone: the app automatically loads the neural IS-Net model compiled in WebAssembly/WebGPU, segments the primary foreground subject, and generates a transparent PNG with real alpha channel in seconds, all within your browser tab.
- [Melhorar qualidade / Enhance quality](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/melhorar-qualidade): Select your preferred upscale multiplier (2x or 4x) and fine-tune the sharpness slider.
- [Vetorizar (SVG) / Vectorize (SVG)](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/vetorizar): Vectorizing converts a fixed raster pixel grid (PNG or JPG) into mathematically defined geometric paths and Bézier curves (SVG).
- [Extrair texto (OCR) / Extract text (OCR)](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/extrair-texto): Drop your photo or screenshot into the tool: the WebAssembly-powered Tesseract OCR engine scans the pixel layout, identifies text lines, and extracts readable text directly in your browser.
- [Cortar / Crop](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/cortar): Drop your image into the canvas and drag the framing handles.
- [Comprimir / Compress](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/comprimir): Drop your image and adjust the quality slider.
- [Redimensionar / Resize](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/redimensionar): Enter your desired width or height in pixels, or choose a percentage reduction.
- [Converter / Convert](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/converter): You can import JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, and BMP files and export them to WebP, JPEG, PNG, PDF, or ICO icons.
- [Imagens para PDF / Images to PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/para-pdf): Drag all your images into the dropzone simultaneously.
- [Favicon / Favicon](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/favicon): Build a multi-resolution .ico from any image.

## PDF Tools

- [Editar / Edit](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/editar): Edit, read and make scanned PDFs searchable — all locally.
- [Juntar PDF / Merge PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/juntar): Drop all your PDF files into the tool, rearrange their order in the document list, and download the unified document.
- [Comprimir PDF / Compress PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/comprimir): Drop your PDF and select a compression profile (Lossless, Light, Medium, or Strong).
- [Dividir PDF / Split PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/dividir): Select pages by clicking their thumbnails, specify custom ranges (e.g.
- [PDF para Imagem / PDF to Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/para-imagem): Drop your PDF, choose your target format (PNG, JPEG, or WebP), and set your desired resolution scale.
- [PDF para Word / PDF to Word](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/para-word): Drop your PDF into the converter: the engine analyzes text blocks, font metrics, and paragraph groupings to assemble a native .docx file compatible with Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and LibreOffice.
- [Organizar PDF / Organize PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/organizar): Document pages are displayed as an interactive thumbnail grid.
- [Proteger PDF / Protect PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/proteger): Drop your PDF file, enter a secure opening password, and download the protected document.
- [Assinar PDF / Sign PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/assinar): Upload your PDF, draw your signature using your mouse, trackpad, or touchscreen, or upload a transparent PNG image of your handwritten signature.
- [Marca d'Água / Watermark PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/marca-dagua): Add a text watermark or logo stamp across your PDF pages.
- [Numerar páginas / Page numbers](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/numerar-paginas): Number the pages of a PDF, without rasterising it.

## Audio Tools

- [Cortar áudio (Aparar MP3) / Cut audio (Trim MP3)](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/cortar): Drop your audio file to render the interactive waveform.
- [Juntar áudio / Merge audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/juntar): Drop all your audio files, arrange track order in the visual playlist, adjust the optional crossfade duration for smooth transitions, and download the combined audio track.
- [Converter áudio / Convert audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/converter): Upload your audio track, choose your target format (MP3, WAV, OGG, or M4A), and select your desired bitrate and channel configuration.
- [Comprimir Áudio / Compress Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/comprimir): Select your target bitrate and optionally enable mono downmixing for spoken word.
- [Normalizar Áudio / Normalize Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/normalizar): Drop your file into Loudness (LUFS) mode: the tool scans perceived loudness across the track, calculates required decibel gain, and applies a transparent look-ahead limiter to prevent distortion and clipping on sudden peaks.
- [Remover silêncio / Remove silence](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/remover-silencio): By RMS over a 20-millisecond window, not sample by sample.
- [Separar canais / Split channels](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/separar-canais): Stereo to mono, one side on its own, or the sides swapped.

## video

- [Gravador de tela / Screen recorder](https://nadasai.com/pt/video/gravar-tela): Open the recorder, choose whether to capture system audio and/or microphone voiceover, and click "Start Recording".
- [Extrair quadros / Extract frames](https://nadasai.com/pt/video/extrair-quadros): Drop the video, use the player controls to land on the frame you want, and click capture.
- [Vídeo para GIF / Video to GIF](https://nadasai.com/pt/video/para-gif): Drop the video file on the upload area, drag the two controls to mark the stretch you want (up to 30 seconds), set the width, the frames per second and the number of colours, and generate.
- [Vídeo para áudio / Video to audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/extrair-de-video): Drop your video file (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, etc.), select your output format (MP3 or lossless WAV), and click download.

## Privacy & Security Tools

- [Criptografar arquivo (AES-256) / Encrypt file (AES-256)](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/criptografar-arquivo): To encrypt, drag and drop any file into the upload zone, select "Encrypt", choose a strong password, and download the encrypted .enc envelope.
- [Hash de arquivo & Checksum / File hash & Checksum](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/hash-de-arquivo): A cryptographic hash is a unique digital fingerprint computed from a file’s exact byte sequence.
- [Gerador de senhas / Password generator](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/gerador-de-senha): Generate strong, unguessable passwords 100% offline with custom rules and entropy calculation.
- [Remover EXIF / GPS / Remove EXIF / GPS](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/remover-exif): Strip private GPS location, camera info, author, and timestamp from your photos.
- [Censurar imagem / Tarja preta / Redact image / Black bar](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/censurar-imagem): Draw black bars over sensitive details — ID numbers, card numbers, addresses and faces.
- [Comparar textos (Diff) / Text diff checker](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/comparar-texto): Paste or drop your two texts into the side-by-side comparison panes (original on the left, modified on the right).
- [Censurar PDF / Tarja preta / Redact PDF / Black bar](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/censurar-pdf): Because standard PDF editors simply place a visual vector rectangle on top of the existing text.
- [Limpar metadados do PDF / Clean PDF metadata](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/limpar-metadados-pdf): PDF files routinely embed the creator’s real name, organization, authoring software (e.g.
- [Criptografar texto (AES-256) / Encrypt text (AES-256)](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/criptografar-texto): Type your message, enter a secret password, and click to generate a Base64-armored text envelope with header tags.
- [QR Code (Gerador & Leitor) / QR Code (Generator & Scanner)](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/qr-code): Select your data type (URL, Wi-Fi credentials, Pix payment, vCard contact, email, or plain text), enter your content, and customize colors and margins.

## Format Conversions

These pages open the converter above with the destination format already selected. They exist because the question behind each pair is specific — whether transparency survives, whether the file grows, whether an animation is kept — and each page answers its own.

- [PNG para JPG / PNG to JPG](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/png-para-jpg): Convert PNG to JPG right in the browser. Transparency is flattened onto white and the file usually drops to a fraction of its size. No signup, no upload.
- [JPG para PNG / JPG to PNG](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/jpg-para-png): Convert JPG to PNG right in the browser. PNG is lossless, so nothing is discarded from here on — but the file grows and quality already lost does not come back.
- [PNG para WebP / PNG to WebP](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/png-para-webp): Convert PNG to WebP right in the browser, transparency preserved. It is the trade that cuts the weight of site imagery without losing the cutout.
- [WebP para PNG / WebP to PNG](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/webp-para-png): Convert WebP to PNG right in the browser, transparency preserved. It is the way out for software and forms that still refuse WebP.
- [JPG para WebP / JPG to WebP](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/jpg-para-webp): Convert JPG to WebP right in the browser. WebP usually delivers the same look in a smaller file — no signup, no upload.
- [WebP para JPG / WebP to JPG](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/webp-para-jpg): Convert WebP to JPG right in the browser. It is the way out for forms, printers and software that only accept JPEG.
- [AVIF para JPG / AVIF to JPG](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/avif-para-jpg): Convert AVIF to JPG right in the browser. AVIF is read here but not written — and this page explains why.
- [GIF para PNG / GIF to PNG](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/gif-para-png): Convert GIF to PNG right in the browser. From an animated GIF you get the first frame: PNG carries no sequence, and the page says so up front.
- [M4A para MP3 / M4A to MP3](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/m4a-para-mp3): Convert M4A to MP3 right in the browser. The audio is decoded and re-encoded on your machine, with no upload and no signup.
- [WAV para MP3 / WAV to MP3](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/wav-para-mp3): Convert WAV to MP3 right in the browser. It is the conversion that trades tens of megabytes for a few, with no upload and no signup.
- [FLAC para MP3 / FLAC to MP3](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/flac-para-mp3): Convert FLAC to MP3 right in the browser. FLAC is read here; writing FLAC is what no browser does, and this page explains why.
- [MP3 para WAV / MP3 to WAV](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/mp3-para-wav): Convert MP3 to WAV right in the browser. WAV is raw PCM: the file grows a lot, and nothing more is discarded from here on.

## Privacy Architecture

The no-upload claim is instrumented rather than asserted: NetworkProbeService wraps fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and WebSocket at runtime and counts file egress specifically (any body carrying a File, Blob, ArrayBuffer, typed array, or FormData containing a File). The count is shown on every page, so a visitor can verify the claim in their own browser rather than taking it on trust.
